name: GE Vernova Inc.
content: GE Vernova Inc. is a global leader in the energy sector, formed as a spin-off from General Electric in 2024. The company is dedicated to electrifying and decarbonizing the world through its diverse portfolio, which includes Power, Wind, and Electrification segments. GE Vernova provides essential technology and services for power generation, including gas, nuclear, hydro, and steam power, as well as onshore and offshore wind turbines. By leveraging its extensive installed base and innovative solutions like the BWRX-300 small modular reactor, the company plays a critical role in the global energy transition toward more sustainable and reliable power systems.

Officers

Scott StrazikApril 2024

Chief Executive Officer

Scott Strazik is the Chief Executive Officer of GE Vernova. He has more than 20 years of operations and leadership experience. Prior to his current role, he served as CEO of GE’s Gas Power business and later as CEO of GE’s Power portfolio. He joined GE in 2000 and has held various leadership roles in finance, operations, and general management.

Ken ParksOctober 2023

Chief Financial Officer

Ken Parks is the Chief Financial Officer of GE Vernova. Before joining GE Vernova, he served as CFO of Owens Corning and previously as CFO of Mylan N.V. He also held senior financial leadership roles at United Technologies Corporation.

Vic AbateApril 2024

CEO, Wind

Vic Abate is the CEO of GE Vernova’s Wind segment. He has over 30 years of experience at GE, having served as GE’s Chief Technology Officer and CEO of GE’s Renewable Energy and Gas Power businesses.
